authority: factory spec § 2.2 condition 7; successor Amendment 2026-10-03 (K1), megareview rulings (3) (ii); Amendment 2026-10-17 (K1) (4)(b) and (5); the inbox rulings of 2026-10-25 (b), (b2) (the windows) and (a) (the always-on fit, c05b47e8); D543
note: One read of the two ruled windows, no p-value, a counted trial, never re-run. X is never on in discovery, so the rulings name the confirmation read: the coefficients are fitted on discovery and frozen in this script before the confirmation's statistic. No request: the held stores, read-only. Strategy-level figures only. script_sha256 = the sha256 of the script at script_path, committed and pushed before the read.
statistic: mean net residual return of the row's book per quarterly cluster over the confirmation: half-notional short SPY and long IEF from the quarter's first open to its last close when X > 0, otherwise cash (0); the residual = the book's net return less beta × the fixed 60/40 SPY/IEF total return over the same interval, beta fitted on discovery to the book held on in every quarter and frozen; the field's ETF cost line, 10 bp a side and 25 bp a year of short borrow
units: bp per quarterly cluster (the row's Stage-1 unit; prior 0.075)

fit.on: the net book on in every discovery quarter (ruling (a)); OLS with an intercept, beta alone used

bar: zero on the registered sign (+): the row declares no baseline bar
pulled_via: the held stores data/fmp-etf.db and data/dashboard.db, read-only (no request)
